description.value: Walmart is a large-format Supercenter on Barnet Highway in Coquitlam, offering a full grocery section alongside general merchandise including clothing, electronics, and household goods. It sits on a major arterial corridor connecting Port Moody and central Coquitlam, making it a practical resupply point for cyclists touring the eastern Metro Vancouver area. As a supercenter-format store, it stocks a broader range of goods than a typical grocery stop.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack (8 spaces) at 46m; stands (2 spaces) at 74m; stands (2 spaces, covered) at 78m; stands (2 spaces) at 87m. Total: 14 spaces.
